purpose: Recheck deterministic neural decoding on the first verified Level-6 model; previous 10M and 20.5M argmax diagnostics stalled on serves. This materially newer checkpoint was trained with self-imitation, but success is not assumed.

seeds.role: reused primary validation, not fresh test

selection_rule: Require all 20 games complete before considering performance. Any truncation disqualifies the entire suite; never add scripted serving. Only a promising complete result warrants further separate-mode verification. Preserve sampled-policy training and reference unchanged.
unchanged: both active training runs and their sampled validation
